caseNameFull: Weatherford, Agent of the South Carolina Enforcement Division v. Bursey

opinions.text: C. A. 4th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 426 U. S. 946.] Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae granted and 15 additional minutes allotted for that purpose. Respondent granted 15 additional minutes for oral argument.
